# Security policy

## Supported versions

Icefin Player is in alpha. Only the latest release (currently a pre-release) receives security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report vulnerabilities privately through GitHub's **Report a vulnerability** button on this repository's Security tab (private vulnerability reporting). Don't open a public issue.

Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and the affected version or commit. You can expect an acknowledgement within 7 days.

Areas of particular interest: theme packages (parsing, the trust levels, script access to the Jellyfin session), the `icefin-theme:` URL scheme, Flatpak permissions, and log redaction.

Vulnerabilities in Jellyfin Server or jellyfin-web belong with the [Jellyfin project](https://jellyfin.org/docs/general/contributing/security/).
